correctness.rationale: Translate and apply an invertible odd multiplier to A={a,a+p,c} in Z2p to obtain {0,p,1}. The three off-diagonal entries of the complex 3x3 frame operator are exactly Fourier moments for site differences 1,p,p-1. They imply Z_even+Z_odd=0, M_even-M_odd=0, conj(Z_even-Z_odd)=0; hence each parity complex moment zero and parity masses equal. Each parity samples a rotated odd regular p-gon, so no one or two positive roots can sum to zero; at least 3 per parity. Exactly three strictly positive masses solve origin-in-triangle iff each positive cyclic gap <=(p-1)/2; unique normalized solution has opposing-sine weights. Gap-composition inclusion–exclusion yields p(p²−1)/24 triangles for each parity, squared supports across two independent parities. Minimal polynomial Phi_p forces any nonempty equal-1 root vanishing set to be all p per parity, so equal-weight minimum 2p. Independently checked all triples for p=3,5,7,11 with admissible per-parity counts 1,5,14,55 and support counts 1,25,196,3025; these finite checks do not replace analytic all-p derivation.
